nodes.description: Owned.owner address; set to msg.sender in Owned constructor and read by onlyOwner modifier.
Token symbol string, set in SeedDAO constructor.
Token name string, set in SeedDAO constructor.
Token decimals, hardcoded to 9 in constructor.
Privileged delegate address; approve() writes number when msg.sender == delegate.
Sentinel address set on first transferFrom and used as a transfer gate in transfer/_send.
Total token supply; increased in _reflect and decreased in reflect.
Threshold value seeded with total supply at construction and overwritten by delegate in approve().
Address stored during reflection; used to bypass the zero-address gate in _send.
mapping(address=>uint) token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) ERC20 allowances.
Public transfer; debits balances[msg.sender] and credits recipient after checking recipient != zero.
Public transferFrom; conditionally sets zero address then moves balances and allowance.
Public approve; sets allowance and writes the number state variable when caller equals delegate.
onlyOwner function that calls _reflect and then subtracts tokens from the target balance and total supply.
Internal virtual function that sets reflector and mints twice the given amount.
Internal view gate that validates the destination address against zero/reflector/number conditions.
SeedDAO constructor; initializes name, symbol, decimals, supply, delegate and owner balance.
Owned constructor assigning owner from msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of a given token owner.
Returns remaining allowance for a spender.
Increases caller's allowance to spender via _approve.
Decreases caller's allowance to spender via _approve.
Private allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Empty receive function accepting ether.
Empty fallback function accepting ether.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded body.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and delegate comparison target.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with no allowance or authorization of the destination.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and overwrites number=tokens whenever msg.sender == delegate.
transferFrom moves balances and decrements allowance without verifying the zero-address gate or spender authorization.
_reflect executes _totalSupply = _totalSupply.add(_reflectAmount*2) minting twice the amount.
Owned constructor grants ownership directly from msg.sender without validation.
_send require() gate combinable with reflector and number allowing zero-address transfers for privileged or small-balance accounts.
_approve writes allowed[_owner][spender] = amount with no authorization that the caller owns _owner.
